map.「被动移动关节至目标角度，患者主动复现，计算位置觉误差」按输入参数进行专业计算并: Passively move a joint to the target angle, have the patient reproduce it actively, and compute the position sense error from the entered parameters.
map.输入复现角度后自动计算误差: The error is computed automatically once the reproduced angles are entered
map.请先在测试模式中完成测试: Complete the test in test mode first
map.本体感觉正常，关节位置觉精确: Proprioception normal, joint position sense precise
map.1. 患者闭目或遮蔽视线: 1. The patient closes the eyes or has vision blocked
map.2. 检查者被动移动患者关节至目标角度，保持3-5秒: 2. The examiner passively moves the patient's joint to the target angle and holds it for 3-5 seconds
map.3. 回到起始位，让患者主动复现该角度: 3. Return to the start position and ask the patient to reproduce that angle actively
map.4. 记录目标角度和复现角度，计算绝对误差: 4. Record the target and reproduced angles and compute the absolute error
map.5. 每个角度测试3次取平均值: 5. Test each angle 3 times and take the average
map.6. 测试多个角度（不同ROM范围）综合评估: 6. Test several angles (across different ROM ranges) for a comprehensive assessment
map.本体感觉受损常见于：关节损伤（韧带撕裂）、神经系统疾病（脑卒中、脊髓损伤）、关节: Proprioception impairment is commonly seen in joint injury (ligament tears), neurological disease (stroke, spinal cord injury), degenerative joint disease (OA) and the postoperative state. Reduced proprioception affects balance and motor control and raises the risk of reinjury.
map.📚 深度解析：本体感觉（关节位置觉）误差测量: 📝A In-depth analysis: proprioception (joint position sense) error measurement
map.目标 30°/复现 33°（过冲 3°）等 4 次平均 3.5°、最大 5°：属: Target 30 degrees / reproduced 33 degrees (3 degrees overshoot), mean 3.5 degrees over 4 trials with a maximum of 5 degrees: judged good,
map.0.9°，方向以过冲为主。: 0.9 degrees, with the direction of error mostly overshoot.
map.平均误差 9°、最大 12°：轻度异常，建议本体感觉训练（平衡板/闭眼站立）改善: Mean error 9 degrees, maximum 12 degrees: mildly abnormal, proprioception training (balance board / eyes-closed standing) is recommended to improve joint position sense.
map.≤3° 优秀、≤5° 良好、≤10° 轻度异常、>10° 明显异常；偏瘫或韧带术: 3 degrees or less excellent, 5 degrees or less good, 10 degrees or less mildly abnormal, above 10 degrees clearly abnormal; after hemiplegia or ligament surgery values are often above 5 degrees.
map.每个目标角度至少测 3 次取平均绝对误差，单次测量波动大、不足以作为结论。测试时: Test at least 3 times for each target angle and take the mean absolute error, since a single measurement varies too much to base a conclusion on. Vision must be blocked and auditory cues removed (such as device noise); do 1-2 demonstrations first (not counted) and alternate the affected and healthy sides to cancel out the learning effect. An absolute error above 5 degrees is generally considered position sense impairment, but it is only reliable when compared with the healthy side at the same angle.
